Game Overview

In Rise of Lava, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling arcade survival adventure in Rise of Lava. Navigate treacherous terrain, outwit relentless lava, and collect shimmering emeralds to enhance your appearance. Coordinate with a friend to boost survival, as both must endure this fiery trial amidst nostalgic pixellated graphics. Can you rise above the flames?
